Hand colored. Relief shown pictorially. Prime meridian: Ferro I. Includes chart showing possessions by Britain, United States, France, Spain, the Dutch, and Denmark. "31." on verso. Scale ca. 1:16,250,000. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. LC copy annotated in black ink. Vault AACR2
